summary: Frontend-only e2e test of new Member Reviews section on KM Nishat 99 landing page. Verified: mentor section removed; reviews-section renders on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844 with heading 'Member Reviews'; ring carousel shows 7 cards (idx 0,5,10,16,22,28,34) that auto-rotate; clicking a card opens the lightbox with correct index (card-0 -> '23/40', card-5 -> '17/40'); prev/next buttons and Arrow keys update counter and wrap correctly; Escape and backdrop click close lightbox; showcase button opens overlay with all 40 items (reviews-showcase-item-0..39); mouse wheel scrolls overlay internally (scrollTop=1200) while page scroll stays locked; clicking reviews-showcase-item-3 opens lightbox with '4/40'; closing lightbox returns to overlay; closing overlay restores page scroll; nav-link-reviews scrolls to the section; drag on carousel does not open lightbox; zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: ReviewCarousel: Card component uses stillness() called on every render (reads window.matchMedia); harmless but could be lifted to a module-level constant or a hook to avoid repeated matchMedia calls per re-render.
ReviewCarousel useFit ResizeObserver assumes ref.current is defined; safe today but a null-guard would be cleaner.

ReviewsGallery overlay selects the internal scroll container via '.overflow-y-auto' class in tests only because it lacks a data-testid; consider adding data-testid='reviews-showcase-scroller' for stable selection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Member Reviews acceptance criteria pass on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Note that page.tap requires hasTouch context; mobile card tap verified via click in browser context. Backdrop-click close only works when the click lands on the outer lightbox div — clicking directly on the image or on the prev/next chevrons (which cover left/right edges due to top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2) will not close; that's expected because their handlers call e.stopPropagation().
